draft.title: Welcome to CajeerEngine Book
draft.body:
Your self-hosted home for technical documentation. Create books, organize pages, and publish changes when they are ready.

## Start here
- [Getting started](/docs/handbook/1.0/getting-started)
- [Authoring guide](/docs/handbook/1.0/authoring)

## Built on CajeerEngine
The original CJR template engine and durable filesystem primitives power this edition. Your documentation stays on your server.

> No cloud account is needed.

draft.title: Getting started
draft.body:
## Run locally
PHP 8.4.1 or newer is needed.

```bash
php -S 127.0.0.1:8080 -t public public/router.php
```

## Manage content
Configure BOOK_ADMIN_HASH and open [Studio](/studio). Save a draft, then publish when ready.

draft.title: Authoring guide
draft.body:
## Markdown
Use headings, lists, **bold**, *emphasis*, inline code and fenced code blocks. Raw HTML is escaped.

## Versions
Create pages with a book, version and path. Copy a published version to drafts before editing a new release.

## Publishing
Saving a draft does not change the published page. Use Publish to replace the public snapshot.
